race.comment: BATISTA (3) disappointed last time out as the race favourite, though stepping out in trip now looks an ideal move. He finished strongly over 1400m two back and now sees the mile for the first time with Fiore on board. Can get back to winning ways now. MYZOOM (1) disappointed last time over 1700m and comes back to the mile here where she was only 1L away two starts back. The inside draw should see her get every chance and she can make an impression. ETERNALLY YOURS (4) steps out tot eh mile again now after getting back and never featuring off a 51-day break. Out to a better trip for him now and he can make his presence felt. LENDANEAR (7) was too good last time out and can feature again out in distance. WRITTEN SIN (12) is third-up now and improvement is on the cards.
